The '''Zoma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zoma V]]. It was possibly close to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
